meta.name: dask
meta.description: Distributed computing for larger-than-RAM pandas/NumPy workflows. Use when you need to scale existing pandas/NumPy code beyond memory or across clusters. Best for parallel file processing, distributed ML, integration with existing pandas code. For out-of-core analytics on single machine use vaex; for in-memory speed use polars.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 在集群上扩展 pandas 与 NumPy 的数据处理能力
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你的 pandas 代码因数据过大而内存溢出
copy.tagline_en: Scale your pandas and NumPy workflows across clusters
copy.fit_line_en: For you if your pandas code runs out of memory with large datasets

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会在数据量超过电脑内存时改用 Dask 的 DataFrame、Array 等接口，沿用你熟悉的 pandas/NumPy 写法，但操作先不真正执行，最后统一计算，还能一次并行处理多个文件。
howto.when: 当你要求处理超出内存的数据集、想把现有 pandas/NumPy 代码并行加速，或需要同时读取多个 CSV、Parquet 文件时触发。

say.text: 帮我把这个文件夹里所有 CSV 合并分析，数据量超过内存。
say.note: Claude 会用 Dask 读取并合并。

say.text: 用 Dask 把这段 pandas 分组统计改成并行版本。
say.note: 会转换为 Dask 延迟计算。

say.text: 我的数组太大，用 Dask 分批算平均值和标准差。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude will recognize datasets too large for memory and use Dask's DataFrame/Array interfaces instead, keeping familiar pandas/NumPy-style code but executing lazily, then computing once, including parallel multi-file processing.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to process datasets exceeding RAM, parallelize existing pandas/NumPy code, or handle multiple CSV/Parquet files at once.

say_en.text: Help me merge all CSVs in this folder; data exceeds memory.
say_en.note: Claude reads and merges with Dask.

say_en.text: Rewrite this pandas groupby as a parallel Dask version.
My array is huge; use Dask to compute mean and std in chunks.
